name: Second text box focus quirk
body:
# Second text box focus quirk

Dean saw a quirk when focusing a second text box (after one already has focus). Not yet reproduced; to be found in the running editor and fixed in the editor, or filed on Penumbra / penumbra-ui-backend if the cause is there.

comments.text: 2026-11-19: could not reproduce a failure. Click Name, type, click Position X, type: focus moves and text goes to the right field. Observed instead that focusing a field puts the caret at the end rather than selecting all, so typing 7 into a 0 gives 07. Waiting on Dean to say what he saw.
